==Quotes==
;Gossip
The island of Tyrandas used to be of spiritual significance for the [[Sisterhood of Elune]] twelve millennia ago. Many of the most devout and respected priestesses completed their religious training in the sacred temple towering above the island.

Now, however, it lies in ruins, abandoned by the Sisterhood. All that remains are its secrets, regrets and mysteries buried beneath a thick layer of shadows.
